name: binaural_wind_down
note: A 30 minute journey of binaural beats, 14 Hz to 10 to 6 to 3, with slow glides between the steps, a soft pad and pink noise. Needs stereo headphones: the two ears hear different tones and the beat forms in the listener's head. No health claim is made. Vary: each stage's minutes (keep them adding up to the piece length), beat_hz per stage, ramp_s (30 to 120).
